【原视频简介】
Keeping fresh vegetables growing in my garden isn't just about planting more—it's about making every growing area work together so there is always something developing for the next harvest.

In this video, I share how I organize my garden to keep a variety of fresh vegetables growing through different stages. Leafy greens fill productive beds and containers, while tomatoes, cucumbers, herbs, and climbing vegetables have their own growing areas and supports.

By combining raised beds, containers, vertical trellises, and well-organized planting zones, I can use the garden efficiently while giving each crop the space it needs. As some vegetables become ready to harvest, others are already growing behind them.

The goal is simple: keep the garden productive instead of relying on one large harvest. With thoughtful planting, good use of available growing areas, and a mix of vegetables at different stages, my garden can provide fresh food one harvest after another.

If you enjoy growing your own vegetables and want inspiration for keeping your garden productive, organized, and full of fresh food, I hope this garden gives you some useful ideas.
